adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

adds.evidence: Cosmo, with the other inhabitants of Knowhere, helps Mantis and Drax decorate the base to cheer up Quill; Mantis tells Kraglin she wants to throw the party.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: Cosmo is one of the team on Knowhere who decorate the base and throw Quill a surprise Christmas party.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: At the Christmas party on Knowhere, Groot gives Drax a wood carving of him flipping a police car, and Drax laughs.

adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who laughs at Groot's carving of him flipping a police car.
adds.evidence: During the celebration Groot gives Drax a wood carving of him flipping the police car, making him laugh.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: Mantis confides in Drax that she wants to give Quill a perfect Christmas gift, and the two fly to Earth together to kidnap Kevin Bacon for him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who flies to Earth with Drax to kidnap Kevin Bacon for Quill.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who flies to Earth with Mantis to kidnap Kevin Bacon for Quill.
adds.evidence: Mantis discusses with Drax her plan to find a perfect present for Quill; they go to Hollywood and take Bacon back to Knowhere.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: Kraglin tells Drax and the others how Yondu once ruined Christmas for young Quill.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian who tells Drax how Yondu ruined Quill's Christmas.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian who hears Kraglin's story of Quill's ruined Christmas.
adds.evidence: Drax notices Quill acting strange; Kraglin explains Christmas is coming, a holiday Yondu ruined for Quill. Opening scene has Nebula, Drax, Kraglin and Mantis together.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: Drax and Nebula hear Kraglin's story of Quill's ruined Christmas together, and both are there when the team surprises Quill with a Christmas party on Knowhere.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.
adds.evidence: Kraglin tells the story to Mantis, Drax and Nebula; both take part in the party. No direct exchange sourced; rests on shared scenes.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who helps kidnap Kevin Bacon as Quill's Christmas present.
adds.evidence: Drax suggests and helps carry out the kidnapping of Bacon as Quill's present; Quill is horrified and Drax insists Bacon is great.

adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: Groot wheels out the gift-wrapped Kevin Bacon for Quill, then claims he thought it was a bad idea. Later Quill gives Groot a Game Boy, and Groot gives him a carving of the kidnapping.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who gives Groot a Game Boy for Christmas.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who wheels out Quill's surprise gift and gives him a carving.
adds.evidence: Groot carts out the present; Quill calls him out for saying it was a bad idea; Quill gives Groot a GameBoy and Groot gives Quill a carving of Drax and Mantis kidnapping Bacon.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: When Kraglin brings up Christmas, Nebula says they have no time for it while they rebuild Knowhere, and the two go back to the repairs.

adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian whose talk of Christmas Nebula brushes off.
adds.evidence: Kraglin says Christmas is coming by the Multi-Calendar; Nebula says they have too much on their plate rebuilding Knowhere; Obfonteri and Nebula return to repair work.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: Kraglin remembers young Quill teaching him about Christmas aboard the Ravager ship. When the team kidnaps Kevin Bacon, Quill has Kraglin ready the ship to take him home, and Kraglin tells Bacon how much he means to Quill.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The boy who taught Kraglin Christmas, now a friend who sends him to fly Bacon home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old Ravager friend who helped him celebrate Christmas as a boy.
adds.evidence: Animated flashback: Quill shows Kraglin Christmas and they make a tree; present day Quill orders Kraglin to prepare the Bowie, and Kraglin tells Bacon about Quill.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special

adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian at Quill's Christmas party on Knowhere.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: In a flashback, Yondu catches Kraglin helping young Quill decorate a Christmas tree, kicks it over and threatens to make them clean the latrines.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Kraglin's captain, who smashes the Christmas tree he and Peter make.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Yondu's first mate, caught decorating a Christmas tree with Peter.
adds.evidence: Yondu walks in on Quill and Kraglin decorating a homemade tree, kicks it away and threatens them with latrine duty; Kraglin mentions Gef.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
adds.text: Nebula brushes off Christmas as a distraction from rebuilding Knowhere, but she later helps decorate for the surprise party Mantis throws Quill.

adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate whose Christmas party for Quill Nebula helps decorate.
adds.evidence: As Mantis speaks about celebrating Christmas to cheer up Quill, Nebula says they have no time for trivialities; on return Nebula helps Mantis set up and decorate Knowhere.

adds.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
